name: Scratch Acid
label: Touch and Go
lede: Scratch Acid lasted five years and well over a hundred shows, long enough for [[David Yow]] to play Jesus on a cross and charge a crowd with cookie dough pulled from his pants, before the band split into [[The Jesus Lizard]] and [[Rapeman]].

eras.title: The singer gets fired, the bass player gets a microphone
eras.text: Scratch Acid started in Austin as a five-piece with Yow on bass and no interest in hardcore's speed limits. Rey Washam told the Statesman they didn't want to sound like East or West Coast punk; the members cite Public Image Ltd, Killing Joke, Chrome and Led Zeppelin. One show in, the singer was gone and Yow had the microphone.

years.h: Scratch Acid forms in Austin, named off a list of word pairs
years.p: Steve Anderson sings, David Yow plays bass, David Wm. Sims and Brett Bradford play guitar and Rey Washam drums. Sims says the name came from long lists of two-word combinations.

years.h: Three instrumentals at Studio 29, and the singer gets no warning
years.p: Steve Anderson is dismissed without notice after Scratch Acid's first show, at Austin's Studio 29. David Wm. Sims moves to bass and David Yow becomes the singer.
years.xp: Per the Austin Chronicle, the band booked the show without telling Anderson, which is why the set was three instrumentals. He later said the decision they made was "the right decision."

years.h: With Yow singing, the real debut pays $20
years.p: At the Skyline Club in Austin, Scratch Acid shares a bill with TSOL, [[Big Boys|fde1cff2-5a7b-4e8c-9666-110fa90500fb]] and [[Butthole Surfers|2339bc21-aa92-4850-86f0-4bb9433910c8]] on March 10, 1983.
years.xp:
Rey Washam left soon after to drum for [[Big Boys|fde1cff2-5a7b-4e8c-9666-110fa90500fb]], and Rich Malley filled in until Washam came back.

Malley's stretch was short. As the Chronicle tells it, they practiced for a month, did a month of shows, and it fell apart.

eras.title: Cookie dough and a cross
eras.text: King Coffey remembered one show with Yow dressed as Hitler, the next as Gibby Haynes and the third on a cross as Jesus. Steve Albini said the cookie dough charge felt like real menace. The band wrote slowly, toured little, and never saw money from its first label.

years.h: The first EP comes out on a local label called Rabid Cat
years.p: Eight songs cut in July 1984 at Earth & Sky Studio in Austin, Greatest Gift among them. Wikipedia says the EP reached No. 26 on the UK indie chart.
years.xp: [[Steve Albini|a4d486bd-6020-4a36-9c7d-bf5ce174bcd1]] told the Statesman the EP "sounded awesome at any speed," and called it one of the first punk records with "a really coherent aesthetic."

years.h: Yow and Lemmy trade "Excuse me" outside the Motörhead bus
years.p: Scratch Acid opens for [[Motörhead|57961a97-3796-4bf7-9f02-a985a8979ae9]] in Dallas in 1985. Yow says he and Lemmy bumped into each other by the bus and each said "Excuse me."

years.h: Just Keep Eating, the band's one full album
years.p: The title is an inside joke about living together and scraping by, the band said. Liner notes later said Rabid Cat and its European distributor never paid them.

years.big: "I'd been drinking a little too much before the show."
years.h: A stage fight in Minneapolis sends Rey Washam home
years.p: Brett Bradford on the 1986 Minneapolis show where he and Washam clash onstage. Washam leaves the tour.
years.xp: Bradford told the Chronicle the two had a blowout, "but we had a disagreement." The band finished the run without Washam and played one last show in Austin before it ended.

yt: Live at Paard van Troje, The Hague, January 7, 1987
years.h: Jean jackets and cowboy boots meet a European winter
years.p: Scratch Acid tours Europe over the winter of 1986–87 in a diesel Mercedes van, with Crime and the City Solution's Simon Bonney as roadie. The Christmas Eve crowd: one bartender and one drunk.
years.xp:
Washam told the Statesman that coming from Texas, they had no idea what real cold was: they showed up in jean jackets and cowboy boots.

Other road stories from the Austin Chronicle: stealing [[Public Image Ltd|68950696-ee9a-49b2-a8c2-d1d6c19355cc]]'s food and drink after John Lydon refused Yow a beer, and [[Joey Ramone|2f3f8fb1-e5dc-4548-9601-fada0485e561]] telling Yow nice show.

eras.title: A last show that pays $1,000
eras.text: One record for Touch and Go, one last show nobody announced, and by 1988 David Wm. Sims, Washam and Yow were in Chicago building Rapeman and The Jesus Lizard.

years.h: Berserker is Scratch Acid's one Touch and Go record
years.p: The last record while the band is still a band, and the first for Touch and Go. According to Wikipedia it reached No. 7 on the UK indie chart.
play: Mary Had a Little Drug Problem

years.h: The last show, at the Cave Club, goes unannounced
years.p: Rey Washam on May 5 at Austin's Cave Club. Nobody announces it as the end; the band plays and stops.
years.xp: Washam added that it was "a huge deal." The Chronicle counts 146 shows across 1982 to 1987; the Statesman's oral history puts the total closer to 120.

years.h: Sims ends up in both new bands, Rapeman and the Jesus Lizard
years.p: Sims and Washam join [[Steve Albini|a4d486bd-6020-4a36-9c7d-bf5ce174bcd1]] in [[Rapeman|899dea17-b403-42e0-9673-2623c40081af]]. Sims and Yow move to Chicago and start [[The Jesus Lizard|dfebd6c0-dae7-4cc8-a8e9-0dbaa382209f]] with [[Duane Denison|6a22c1ff-42c8-4c53-afa8-58f4766b9096]].

eras.title: The Greatest Gift
eras.text: Touch and Go gathered everything onto one disc, and the members went on to Ministry, the Melvins, accounting and acting. In 2006 the original four came back for Touch and Go's birthday.

years.h: Touch and Go puts everything on one disc, The Greatest Gift
years.p: The compilation collects the self-titled EP, Just Keep Eating and Berserker.
years.xp: Rey Washam went on to drum for [[Ministry|13df2a46-f72f-40e7-aa63-26fcf62c7048]], [[Helios Creed|26a13357-fad6-4900-a324-ff252e681112]], [[The Didjits|e3d01dcb-eb41-4ce9-8506-bfd70aa8d651]], [[Lard|4430600b-0fdb-43a1-be52-c81aa7ab1682]] and [[Tad|867d3fb7-9cd1-47a4-a8f0-de29cdca2004]], and sometimes the [[Melvins|9ccfbc94-a4f4-42f7-b6f5-d903ab77cccb]]. Brett Bradford stayed in Austin and played in Great Caesar's Ghost, Sangre de Toro, Areola 51 and later Suckling.

years.cap: Scratch Acid at the Showbox, Seattle, September 16, 2006
years.h: The original four get back on stage at Emo's
years.p: After four days of six- to eight-hour practices, Scratch Acid plays Emo's on September 2, Touch and Go's 25th anniversary in Chicago on September 9, and Seattle's Showbox on September 16.
years.xp: Washam told the Statesman it was strange counting off the first song after 25 years: "like we learned how to play." Bradford said playing together again was "a lot more challenging than anyone thought."

years.cap: Scratch Acid at Union Transfer, Philadelphia, November 5, 2011
years.h: First US tour in 24 years, announced on Facebook
years.p: David Yow posts the dates on August 31, 2011, and the November and December run includes Philadelphia's Union Transfer on November 5.

years.cap: Scratch Acid at Union Transfer, Philadelphia, November 5, 2011
years.h: Jeff Mangum books Scratch Acid for ATP
years.p: All Tomorrow's Parties, curated by [[Neutral Milk Hotel|a506f761-2c22-4b2f-8a94-bd748c2c8f75]]'s [[Jeff Mangum|6a7b9d5e-a863-4a90-a056-77942e9f43de]] and held March 9 to 11, brings the band its first UK show since the 1986–87 tour.
